answer: Make each epoch proof memory-hard, not merely CPU-hard: every identity must fill and hash a large crystal lattice of RAM to answer. The fable that fakes are cheap dies at the wharf of physical memory, because a farmer cannot amortize one big rig across a thousand heads when each head needs its own gigabytes resident at once. Honest solo: one buffer, cheap. Farm: N buffers in parallel, and memory does not parallelize away like raw hashing, so cost climbs with head count and cannot be traded for time.
